Content: The polynomial function `p` is given by `p(x)=-4x^5+3x^2+1`. Which of the following statements about the end behavior of `p` is true?

A.Choice: The sign of the leading term of `p` is `text(positive)`, and the degree of the leading term of `p` is `text(even)`; therefore, `lim_(x->-oo)p(x)=oo` and `lim_(x->oo)p(x)=oo`.

B.Choice: The sign of the leading term of `p` is `text(negative)`, and the degree of the leading term of `p` is `text(odd)`; therefore, `lim_(x->-oo)p(x)=oo` and `lim_(x->oo)p(x)=-oo`
